claim: La Dimora is Da Vittorio's on-site 10-room Relais & Châteaux hotel at Via Cantalupa 17, Brusaporto; Junior Suite €700, Double €650, breakfast included.

claim: The Cantalupa estate covers ten hectares with two lakes linked by a strolling path, plus tennis court and 5-a-side pitch; about ten minutes by car from Bergamo.
quote: ten hectares of grounds... two natural lakes... linked by a path ideal for a relaxing stroll... ten minutes by car from Bergamo.

claim: Da Vittorio holds three stars in the 2026 Michelin Guide Italia.

quote: Da Vittorio is approximately a 19-minute walk from the hotel.
